title: Demo Days in Cleveland, OH
summary: Massimo Motor is hosting a Demo Day at the Midstates show in Cleveland, OH. Visitors can test drive the rugged Buck 450, the popular Mini 125, and the highly anticipated MVR HVAC, which features a fully enclosed cabin with full heat and A/C.
body_markdown:
Massimo Motor is hosting a Demo Day at the Midstates show in Cleveland, OH. Visitors can test drive the rugged Buck 450, the popular Mini 125, and the highly anticipated MVR HVAC, which features a fully enclosed cabin with full heat and A/C.
